completion_note: 132 complete CUDA responses recovered and reviewed (base plus checkpoint 30). Runtime disappeared during checkpoint-60 inference; remaining comparisons were completed separately on MPS, not pooled with this cohort.
scope: 54 existing validation items and 12 post-final development diagnostics per model; not untouched final evidence, no primary pass rates or statistical improvement claim.

30.decision: Reject checkpoint 30 under the existing development rule: degenerate output and unsafe/unsupported guidance. Do not send it to a final test.
